HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 18.01.2023 CRL.M.A. 1316/2023 (Exemption) Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application is disposed of accordingly.

The present application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. seeks extension of interim bail granted to the applicant by this Court vide order dated 05.01.2023, in case FIR No.512/2022 under Sections 307/498A/34 IPC, registered at PS Ranhola.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the expected date of delivery of the applicants wife was initially 09.01.2023.
However, due to some medical complications, as per the doctors prescription dated 14.01.2023, the expected date of delivery is now scheduled for 21.01.2023.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to verify the documents annexed with the present application.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.
